recommend_inspection.description: Recommend a human technician inspect the asset. Non-destructive. No physical action taken.
recommend_inspection.notes: High severity forces human review even though autonomous_allowed is true. Registry wins.

notify_engineer.description: Send notification to on-call engineer. No physical action.

schedule_maintenance.description: Insert a maintenance task into the operations queue. Deferred action, no immediate physical effect.

reduce_motor_load.description: Instruct motor controller to reduce operating load by a configured percentage. Physical effect, reversible.
reduce_motor_load.notes: Autonomous not allowed. Human review mandatory. Short expiry: load decisions are time-sensitive.

vent_pressure.description: Open pressure relief valve. Irreversible during operation. Physical hazard if personnel nearby.
vent_pressure.notes: personnel_nearby must be false. Safety layer must be available. Any failure blocks. No queuing.

emergency_shutdown.description: Full motor shutdown. Routes to safety layer. Nano governs the recommendation path only; actual shutdown is safety layer responsibility.
emergency_shutdown.notes: Nano does not execute shutdown. Nano validates and routes to safety layer. Safety layer acts independently. Nano must never delay this routing.
